test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

The CEO has _____________ than worrying about individual customer complaints.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom** "bigger fish to fry"** means **having more important or more interesting things to do.**
 
• It fits the sentence context, indicating that **the CEO has more significant responsibilities than dealing with individual customer complaints.**
 
• The correct idiom for the fill in the blank is 'bigger fish to fry'.​
 
• Therefore, the correct statement is **"The CEO has bigger fish to fry __than worrying about individual customer complaints."**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• The other options do not logically complete the sentence:
 
 
• **"Taken a rain check"** suggests postponing something, which doesn't fit the context of the CEO's priorities.
 
• **"Thrown caution to the wind"** means to take a risk, which doesn't align with the idea of having more important tasks.
 
• **"Been walking on thin ice" **means being in a risky or precarious situation, which is not appropriate here.
